{{Top}}
[[File:The_idiot.svg|thumb|200px|The Idiot as it appeared in certain sabacc decks]]
The '''Idiot''' was a card that was part of a standard [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck. Its value within the game was, in most variations on the rules, zero. However it, along with a two and a three of any suit, was essential to form the [[Idiot's Array/Legends|Idiot's Array]], which was the top hand that a player could have, trumping even [[Pure Sabacc/Legends|Pure Sabacc]].
